title: PayPal pricing - 2.2%-4.99% + flat fee depending on volume and transaction type
clean_text: PayPal charges 2.99% + $0.49 for standard Goods & Services transactions, or 3.49% + $0.49 as the default PayPal Checkout rate for US merchants. International transactions are 4.99% plus a fixed fee, with currency conversion adding roughly 3.5% (a 3-4% markup over mid-market FX rates). In-person payments via PayPal Here are 2.7% per swipe. High-volume sellers (100+ transactions/month) qualify for Merchant Services rates as low as 2.2% + $0.30. Chargebacks cost $20 and disputes cost $15-$30 depending on transaction size; combined with FX spreads and surcharges, real effective cost on some transaction types can exceed 8% versus the advertised 2.99% headline rate.
